question: Where is the nearest restaurant you encounter heading toward Green rooftop garden at design building, Amherst, MA from Bidwell House Museum, Monterey, MA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Bidwell House Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Monterey%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Green rooftop garden at design building%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Amherst%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point s, end_point e WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' -- Filter for restaurants that are closer to the destination than to the origin, -- ensuring they are "heading toward" the destination. AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, e.geometry::geography) < ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, s.geometry::geography) ORDER BY -- Order by distance from the starting point to find the "nearest you encounter". ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, s.geometry::geography) LIMIT 1;
